purpose: Collected source for later integration; not installed on the project website.

files.krink-screensaver.js: Original Oa class plus its original ka helper, extracted from the bundle.
files.krink-screensaver.css: Original feature CSS and the five utility rules required by the overlay.
files.krink-screensaver.html: Original overlay and image URL data; fragment, not a complete page.
files.krink-reference.json: Provenance, behavior, original source, and verification history.

integration: Insert krink-screensaver.html into the page body.
Load krink-screensaver.js after the fragment, then call new Oa().
initialization_note: The original site uses l||new Oa within its page initializer. This collection preserves the class without automatically starting it.
dependencies: Browser DOM and timer APIs; no third-party JavaScript library required for this extracted class.
Six original external Krink image URLs retained in the HTML fragment; image files are not bundled.
limitations: Fixed initialization timer, not global inactivity detection.
Dismissal does not restart the timer.
Original asynchronous image-load and timer behavior preserved.
Live visual comparison has not been performed; future integration needs browser validation.
